lens: A busy weekend of signings led by defense and industrials: TTM agreed to buy Epiq Solutions from Veritas for ~$1.1B (Guggenheim), Gentherm and Modine advanced a Reverse Morris Trust combination (Barclays, BofA), and HomeTrust struck a $448M bank merger with Blue Ridge (Piper Sandler) — on top of live Accelerant, Caesars and Payoneer processes, as the pure-play advisers finally caught a bid.

stories.headline: TTM Technologies to acquire Epiq Solutions from Veritas Capital for ~$1.1B; Guggenheim advises TTM
stories.why_it_matters: TTM Technologies (Nasdaq: TTMI) agreed to acquire Epiq Solutions — an ITAR-free provider of software-defined radios and RF/embedded computing for defense and government — from Veritas Capital for ~$1.1B all-cash, expected to close Q4 2026. Per TTM's 8-K, Guggenheim Securities is exclusive financial adviser to TTM (buy-side; Polsinelli legal); JPMorgan, BofA and Barclays are providing committed financing (lenders, not advisers). A defense-electronics acquisition runs ITAR/regulatory, financing and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Guggenheim (TTM) — a ~$1.1B defense-electronics acquisition runs ITAR/CFIUS, committed-financing and integration diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: TTM agrees to acquire Epiq Solutions from Veritas (~$1.1B)

stories.headline: Gentherm to combine with Modine's Performance Technologies unit via a Reverse Morris Trust; Barclays advises Gentherm, BofA advises Modine
stories.why_it_matters: Gentherm (Nasdaq: THRM) will acquire Modine's Performance Technologies Business through a spin-off (Platinum SpinCo) and merger — a tax-efficient Reverse Morris Trust structure with ~$25M in identified annual synergies; the registration statement went effective Aug 12 and a Gentherm special meeting is set for Sept 10. Per the joint proxy/prospectus, Barclays is financial adviser to Gentherm and BofA Securities is financial adviser to Modine. A spin-and-merge runs separation, tax-opinion (Section 355), exchange-ratio and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Barclays (Gentherm) and BofA (Modine) — a Reverse Morris Trust spin-and-merge runs separation, tax-opinion and dual shareholder-vote diligence a secure room organizes to close.
stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Gentherm/Platinum SpinCo Form 425 (joint proxy/prospectus)

stories.headline: HomeTrust to acquire Blue Ridge Bankshares for ~$448M all-stock; Piper Sandler advises HomeTrust
stories.why_it_matters: HomeTrust Bancshares (NYSE: HTB) agreed to acquire Blue Ridge Bankshares (NYSE American: BRBS) in an all-stock merger valued at ~$448.1M ($4.28/share; 0.086 HTB per BRBS share), expanding HomeTrust into Virginia and creating a Southeast commercial bank with $7B+ in assets; expected to close early Q1 2027. The release names Piper Sandler as financial adviser to HomeTrust (buy-side); Stephens advised Blue Ridge. A bank merger runs regulatory-approval and dual shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Piper Sandler (HomeTrust) — a ~$448M bank merger runs regulatory-approval and dual-company proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: HomeTrust agrees to acquire Blue Ridge Bankshares (~$448M)

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Blue Ridge / HomeTrust merger press release (EX-99.1)

stories.headline: Skye Bioscience to merge with Redx in a reverse merger forming fibrosis co Fibrx, alongside a PIPE; Stifel advises Skye
stories.why_it_matters: Skye Bioscience (Nasdaq: SKYE) agreed to a reverse merger with Redx to form 'Fibrx,' a clinical-stage fibrosis-focused company, alongside a PIPE and Series A financing (Skye had paused nimacimab and engaged an adviser to evaluate options). The release names Stifel as exclusive financial adviser to Skye (Morrison Foerster legal); Wedbush PacGrow advised Redx, with Leerink and MTS as placement agents. A reverse merger with concurrent financing runs registration, PIPE and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Stifel (Skye) — a reverse merger with a concurrent PIPE runs registration, financing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.
stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Skye Bioscience joint proxy (EX-99)

stories.headline: Accelerant's $4B+ Thoma Bravo take-private at $20.25/share advances; Morgan Stanley and Houlihan Lokey advise Accelerant, Wells Fargo advises Thoma Bravo
stories.why_it_matters: Accelerant Holdings (NYSE: ARX), the specialty-insurance risk-exchange platform, is being taken private by Thoma Bravo at $20.25/share (49% premium; $4B+ enterprise value). Morgan Stanley is exclusive financial adviser to Accelerant's Board and Houlihan Lokey advises the Special Committee (sell-side); BMO Capital Markets and Wells Fargo advise Thoma Bravo (buy-side). Altamont Capital and the founders intend to roll equity. A sponsor take-private of an insurance-tech platform runs committed-financing, insurance-regulatory and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Morgan Stanley/Houlihan Lokey (Accelerant) and Wells Fargo (Thoma Bravo) — a $4B+ insurance-tech take-private runs committed-financing, insurance-regulatory and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Accelerant agrees to $20.25/share take-private by Thoma Bravo ($4B+ EV)

stories.headline: Dynatrace's $915M acquisition of AI-observability firm Arize advances; JPMorgan advises Dynatrace
stories.why_it_matters: Dynatrace (NYSE: DT) is acquiring Arize — an AI-observability company — in a cash-and-stock deal valued at $915M (~$815M cash plus replacement equity), expanding its AI-monitoring stack; expected to close early in Dynatrace's fiscal Q3 subject to regulatory review. J.P. Morgan advises Dynatrace (buy-side); Qatalyst advised Arize. An AI/software acquisition runs technology, IP and integration diligence workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage JPMorgan (Dynatrace) — an AI-observability acquisition runs technology, IP and integration diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Dynatrace agrees to acquire Arize for $915M

stories.source: Dynatrace press release (Dynatrace to Acquire Arize)

stories.headline: Caesars' $31.00/share Fertitta take-private proxy remains on file; PJT Partners advises Caesars, Morgan Stanley advises Fertitta
stories.why_it_matters: Caesars Entertainment (Nasdaq: CZR) has a preliminary merger proxy (PREM14A, filed Aug 12) on file for its $31.00/share cash take-private by Fertitta Entertainment. PJT Partners is Caesars' exclusive financial adviser and fairness-opinion provider (sell-side), Morgan Stanley advises Fertitta (buy-side), and Jefferies advised the Icahn Group. A large gaming take-private runs committed-financing, multi-state gaming-license and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage PJT Partners (Caesars) and Morgan Stanley (Fertitta) — a $31.00/share gaming take-private runs committed-financing, gaming-license and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Caesars board approves $31.00/share merger with Fertitta

stories.headline: Payoneer's $7.40/share Nuvei merger proxy remains on file; Goldman advises Nuvei
stories.why_it_matters: Payoneer Global (Nasdaq: PAYO) has a definitive merger proxy (DEFM14A, filed Aug 11) on file for its $7.40/share cash acquisition by Nuvei (Neon Maple Parent). Goldman Sachs advises Nuvei (buy-side); Qatalyst advised Payoneer. A cross-border fintech/payments take-private runs antitrust, money-transmitter-licensing and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Goldman (Nuvei) on the Payoneer acquisition — a cross-border payments take-private runs multi-jurisdiction licensing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

stories.headline: Skyworks' $2.0B senior-notes raise for the Qorvo combination remains on file; Goldman, BofA, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo lead
stories.why_it_matters: Skyworks Solutions has an underwriting agreement on file (dated Aug 4, filed Aug 10) for a $2.0B three-part senior-notes offering with a special mandatory redemption tied to its pending Qorvo combination. Goldman Sachs, BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo Securities are named as representatives of the underwriters. Acquisition-financing debt raises run disclosure and syndicate-diligence workstreams alongside the M&A track.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Goldman/BofA/JPMorgan/Wells Fargo on the Skyworks notes — acquisition-financing raises run alongside the Qorvo M&A diligence a secure room keeps organized across both workstreams.
stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Skyworks Solutions underwriting agreement (EX-1.1)

stories.headline: Advisory stocks bounce to start the week — EVR +2.5%, LAZ +3.9% — as the deal calendar stays busy; Jefferies still lags
stories.why_it_matters: A mixed tape midday Aug 17 (S&P +0.26% to ~7,773, Nasdaq +0.45%, Dow -0.79% to ~53,551), with the VIX easing to ~15.0 and the 10Y near ~4.70%. After three straight down sessions, the pure-play advisers snapped back — Evercore +2.5%, Lazard +3.9%, Goldman +1.0%, Morgan Stanley +1.3% — though Jefferies still lagged (-1.5%). The rebound coincides with a full weekend deal slate (TTM/Epiq $1.1B, Gentherm/Modine, HomeTrust/Blue Ridge, plus live Accelerant, Caesars and Payoneer processes) — a reminder that the mandate calendar, not the day's tape, is the read on advisory pipeline.
stories.suggested_action: Lean on the deal flow, not the day's tape — an advisory-stock bounce alongside a busy weekend signing slate is a cue to keep the conversation on live-process execution and room readiness.

After three straight down sessions, the pure-play advisers snapped back: Evercore +2.5%, Lazard +3.9%, with Goldman +1.0%, Morgan Stanley +1.3% and JPMorgan +1.1% — Jefferies (-1.5%) the lone laggard. The bounce lands alongside a busy weekend deal slate (TTM/Epiq $1.1B, Gentherm/Modine, HomeTrust/Blue Ridge). Values are live Aug 17 midday levels.

The mandate calendar, not the day's tape, is the read on pipeline. Which of your live processes has the nearest diligence milestone this week?
